workflow.title: Agents in the daily loop
workflow.body: Claude Code, MCP servers and LangGraph do the heavy lifting. Hard-coded guardrails, not the model, get the final say.

projects.title: Yap
projects.pitch: Speak in Hinglish, English, Hindi or Marathi and Yap types clean, ready-to-send text in any app, even turning Hinglish into polished English.

story.label: Problem
story.text: typing on a phone is slow, and most voice typing breaks the moment you mix Hindi and English the way people actually talk.

story.label: Built
story.text: an Android app with a floating dictation bubble that works in any text box. AI cleanup removes fillers and fixes punctuation, with voice editing and read-aloud, on a Cloudflare Workers backend.

story.label: Result
story.text: speak in Hinglish, English, Hindi or Marathi and get clean, ready-to-send text, even Hinglish turned into polished English. Now in a private pilot.

projects.title: Agent Office
projects.pitch: A dev team of Claude Code agents you run from your phone. You give the order; they plan, build, review and test it as pull requests; you tap merge.

story.label: Problem
story.text: coding agents need constant babysitting, and you can't supervise them away from your desk.

story.label: Built
story.text: an Orchestrator splits orders into tasks; specialist agents work in parallel in their own git worktrees, and a Reviewer and QA agent check every PR before it reaches you.

story.label: Result
story.text: a phone-installable PWA with push notifications that approve plans and merge PRs, plus per-agent budgets, deny rules and a kill switch.

projects.title: Dolphin
projects.pitch: Open-source persistent memory for LLM apps and AI agents: vector search plus a knowledge graph.

story.label: Problem
story.text: LLM apps and agent sessions forget everything between conversations.

story.label: Built
story.text: a Python SDK (add, search, get_context) and an MCP server + Claude Code plugin; an LLM extracts subject-relationship-object triples into a graph, and recall walks one hop out so related facts surface even with no shared words.

story.label: Result
story.text: runs fully local (SQLite, ONNX embeddings, Ollama), published on PyPI as dolphin-memory; my most-starred repo.

projects.title: Tokenmeter
projects.pitch: A local-first Windows dashboard for Claude Code usage: tokens, costs, cache savings and activity, fully offline.

story.label: Problem
story.text: heavy Claude Code users can't see where their tokens and money go.

story.label: Built
story.text: an Electron app that reads local session files and shows cost, cache savings, a 30-day projection, a 90-day heatmap, peak hours and per-project sparklines.

story.label: Result
story.text: zero telemetry, no API keys, a system-tray counter and a pixel companion; shipped as installer and portable builds.

projects.title: Janus
projects.pitch: An AI revenue-recovery agent for failed payments, broken mandates and overdue B2B invoices. Razorpay Buildathon, Track 03.

story.label: Problem
story.text: revenue leaks through failed debits, revoked mandates and late invoices, each handled reactively with no record of what was tried.

story.label: Built
story.text: one agent that detects, diagnoses the root cause, picks a bounded action on an escalating channel ladder (nudge, SMS/email, voice, human) and reports ₹ at risk vs ₹ recovered.

story.label: Result
story.text: guardrails written as tested code, not prompts, that can override the LLM; a full replayable audit trail and a live recovery dashboard.

projects.title: BharatPrivacyPrint
projects.pitch: Send your Aadhaar or PAN to a print shop without leaving a copy behind. Files are encrypted on your phone, and the link self-destructs after printing.

story.label: Problem
story.text: every Aadhaar or PAN sent to a print shop over WhatsApp, email or USB stays on their computer for good, with no way to delete it.

story.label: Built
story.text: a PWA that encrypts the document on your phone (AES-256-GCM, key only in the URL fragment), then shares a link that expires after N opens or N minutes, with an optional PIN.

story.label: Result
story.text: the print shop opens the link, it auto-prints, and the link self-destructs. The server only ever sees encrypted blobs. Free, no account, Hindi first with 22 Indian languages.
